findings.location: source.html — paragraph mentioning favorite song (third paragraph)
findings.source_quote: Her favorite song was ‘Saviour, Like a Shepherd Lead Us’ and although she couldn’t read yet, she knew it was number eight.
findings.suggested_fix: Translate the quoted song title into French to match the rest of the translated hymn text and to avoid leaving substantive quoted prose in English. Replace the English title within the sentence while preserving punctuation and emphasis. For example: « Son chant préféré était ‹Sauveur, comme un berger conduis‑nous› et, bien qu’elle ne sût pas encore lire, elle savait que c’était le numéro huit. »
findings.translation_quote: Son chant préféré était « Saviour, Like a Shepherd Lead Us » et bien qu’elle ne sût pas encore lire, elle savait que c’était le numéro huit.

findings.location: source.html — paragraph where Ellie asks Grandpa (paragraph with direct request)
findings.source_quote: “Do you think you could lead the song ‘Saviour, Like A Shepherd Lead Us’ this next Sunday? I would really like to sing it again!”
findings.suggested_fix: Translate the quoted song title into French inside the child’s spoken request, preserving direct-speech punctuation and HTML/quote structure. For example: « ‹Penses‑tu pouvoir diriger le chant ‹Sauveur, comme un berger conduis‑nous› dimanche prochain ? J’aimerais vraiment le chanter à nouveau !› »
findings.translation_quote: « Grand‑père, » demanda‑t‑elle. « Penses‑tu pouvoir diriger le chant ‘Saviour, Like A Shepherd Lead Us’ dimanche prochain ? J’aimerais vraiment le chanter à nouveau ! »

findings.location: source.html — later paragraph announcing hymn number (when song leader announces)
findings.source_quote: “Let’s sing number 8 in the Appendix,” announced the song leader. Ellie’s heart sang.
findings.suggested_fix: Although the line itself does not quote the hymn title, the surrounding text refers to the same hymn; ensure any nearby explicit references to the hymn title (if present) are translated. No change needed to this sentence unless you intend to include the hymn title here instead of the number; if so, translate the title into French and place it inside the announcement. Example (if you choose to include the title): « ‘Chantons le numéro 8 de l’Appendice — ‹Sauveur, comme un berger conduis‑nous›, » annonça le chantre. »
findings.translation_quote: « Chantons le numéro 8 de l’Appendice, » annonça le chantre. Le cœur d’Ellie chanta.
